name: SonicMeet
tagline: SonicMeet supports 60+ languages for live bilingual captions in Google Meet, Zoom, and Teams. No bot joins. Freemium.
description: SonicMeet is built for multilingual standups, design reviews, and all-hands. It offers live bilingual captions in 60+ languages for Google Meet, Zoom, and Microsoft Teams, with Instant mode for speed and Accurate mode for denser technical talk. No bot joins the call. Keep notes and transcripts, then share AI recaps. Available as a Chrome/Edge extension and Windows/Mac desktop app under freemium pricing.
